meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 引导把旧版单机器人 Slack 安装迁移成每个 agent group 一个独立 Slack 应用（slack-<slug>），保留原有身份、工作区、记忆和接线行为；也支持选择留在经典版并记录该决定。从不创建 agent group，也不修改现有工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示 Slack agents 要求时，或之后任何时间手动触发。

say.text: 把 Slack 迁到每个 agent group 一个独立 app
say.note: 会先检测经典状态并询问是否迁移。

say.text: 我们留在经典 Slack，不迁移
say.note: 记录此选择以满足更新要求，不改动任何东西。

say.text: 先显示这次 Slack 迁移的映射计划
say.note: 展示 dry-run 表待你确认后继续。

howto.what_en: Guides migrating a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app (slack-<slug>) per agent group, preserving identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior. Also records the operator's choice to stay on classic. Never creates agent groups or edits agent workspaces.
howto.when_en: Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

say_en.text: Migrate our Slack to one app per agent group.
say_en.note: Detects classic state and asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: We'll stay on the classic Slack setup.
say_en.note: Records that choice; no changes are made.

say_en.text: Show the planned mapping for this Slack migration.
say_en.note: Displays dry-run table for approval before continuing.
